p: Keep ye judgment: God shows what he requires of them after he has delivered them: that is, the works of charity by which true faith is declared.
righteousness to be revealed: Which I will declare toward you, and pour into your hearts by my Spirit.
sabbath from profaning it: Under the Sabbath he comprehends the whole service of God and true religion.

hath joined himself to the LORD: Let no one think himself unfit to receive the graces of the Lord: for the Lord will take away all impediments, and will forsake no one who will keep his true religion, and believe in him.
house and within my walls a: Meaning, in his Church.
name better than of sons and: They will be called after my people, and be of the same religion: yea, under Christ the dignity of the faithful will be greater than the Jews were at that time.

offerings and their sacrifices shall be: By this he means the spiritual service of God, to whom the faithful offer continual thanksgiving, yea themselves and all that they have, as a lively and acceptable sacrifice.
all people: Not only for the Jews, but for all others, Mt 21:13.

beasts of the field: Meaning, the enemies of the Church, as the Babylonians, Assyrians, etc thus he speaks to scare the hypocrites and to assure the faithful that when this comes they may know it was told to them before.

watchmen are blind: He shows that this affliction will come through the fault of the governors, prophets and pastors, whose ignorance, negligence, greed and obstinacy provoked God's wrath against them.

morrow shall be as this day: We are well yet, and to morrow will be better: therefore let us not fear the plagues before they come: thus the wicked contemned the admonition and exhortations which were made to them in the Name of God.
